description: An interface ORDERS a mantle's boundary and may not redefine it. The declared interface here omits two of the sub-net's four free ports, which is refused (`box-interface`) rather than silently giving the box a smaller arity. This is the rule that keeps a box from being a second source of truth about its own mantle: the free ports ARE the interface, and the declaration exists only because the parent addresses them by index and a set has no indices. The same error covers naming a port that is not free (one already wired inside — i.e. trying to expose an inner connection) and repeating one.
